en.title: Swaw Banyan · Authorization Manager
en.preparing: Preparing tools; first use requires downloads…
en.existing: A default credential exists. Saving will replace it.
en.invalidSession: Open the complete local URL printed by swban.
en.saved: Saved. You can continue setup or close this page.
en.cancelled: Closed. You can close this page.
en.closed: Connection closed. Run the swban command again.

errors.invalid_cloudflare_account_id: Account ID must contain 32 hexadecimal characters.
errors.cloudflare_token_verification_failed: Verification failed. Check the Token, expiry and network. Account tokens also need an Account ID.
errors.busy: An operation is in progress. Please wait.
errors.login_failed: Authorization failed. Check the terminal message and try again.
errors.tool_preparation_failed: Tool preparation failed. Check the terminal and network, then retry.
errors.credential_store_failed: Cannot save to Windows Credential Manager. The existing credential was not deleted.
errors.invalid_tencent_key: Enter a valid SecretId and SecretKey. This form stores long-term keys only.
errors.tencent_key_verification_failed: Identity verification failed. Check the key, status, network and local clock.

cloudflare.environmentHint: CLOUDFLARE_* names take priority over CF_* aliases. Validity is not checked.
cloudflare.loginFlow: Authorize cf and Wrangler separately, as needed.
cloudflare.loginPermissions: Default scopes cover Pages deployment. If you customize them, keep at least Pages Edit permission.
cloudflare.loginStorage: Each tool controls credential encryption and sharing.
cloudflare.storage: The system credential manager stores credentials for Banyan's cf and Wrangler tools.

tencent.loginFlow: Sign-in inherits all permissions of the signed-in user. To limit permissions, use a CAM sub-user.
tencent.loginPermissions: Each tool controls credential encryption and sharing.
tencent.loginStorage: For tccli, we recommend API Token. Credentials are stored encrypted, and setup is simple.
tencent.login: Sign in to Tencent Cloud first
tencent.permissions: Access keys inherit all permissions of their owner. For limited access, use keys from a CAM sub-user with restricted permissions.
tencent.verification: This check verifies identity only, not product permissions.
tencent.storage: The system credential manager stores credentials for Banyan's tccli.
tencent.environmentHint: Environment variables cannot be set here. Only presence is checked, not validity.

en.priority: Priority: sign-in < API Token < environment variables (one method is enough).

zh.title: Swaw Banyan · 授权管理
zh.preparing: 正在准备工具，首次使用需下载…
zh.ready: 工具已就绪，授权未确认
zh.invalidAccount: 已设置，账户 ID 格式无效
zh.existing: 已存在默认凭据。保存会替换它。
zh.invalidSession: 请打开 swban 命令显示的完整本机地址。
zh.saved: 已保存。可以继续设置或关闭此页面。
zh.cancelled: 已结束。可以关闭此页面。
zh.closed: 连接已关闭，请重新运行 swban 命令。

errors.invalid_cloudflare_token: 请输入有效的 API Token。
errors.invalid_cloudflare_account_id: 账户 ID（Account ID）必须是 32 位十六进制字符。
errors.cloudflare_token_verification_failed: 验证失败。请检查 Token、有效期和网络；账户令牌（Account）还需填写账户 ID。
errors.login_failed: 授权失败，请查看终端提示后重试。
errors.tool_preparation_failed: 工具准备失败，请检查终端提示和网络后重试。
errors.credential_store_failed: 无法保存到 Windows 凭据管理器。原有凭据未主动删除。
errors.invalid_tencent_key: 请输入有效的 SecretId 和 SecretKey；这里只保存长期密钥。
errors.tencent_key_verification_failed: 身份验证失败，请检查密钥、状态、网络和本机时间。

cloudflare.environmentHint: CLOUDFLARE_* 变量优先于 CF_* 别名；不检查是否有效。
cloudflare.loginFlow: cf 与 Wrangler 需分别授权，按需选择工具。
cloudflare.loginPermissions: 默认授权范围已覆盖 Pages 部署；自定义时至少保留 Pages 编辑权限。
cloudflare.loginStorage: 凭据是否加密存储、会否共用，均为工具自己处理。
cloudflare.permissions: 授权须包含 Pages 编辑权限。
cloudflare.account: Account ID（仅 Account API Token 需填）
cloudflare.storage: 密钥会存入系统凭据管理器，供 banyan 内部的 cf 和 Wrangler 使用。

tencent.loginFlow: 会继承登录用户的所有权限；要限制权限，请用 CAM 子用户。
tencent.loginPermissions: 凭据是否加密存储、会否共用，均为工具自己处理。
tencent.loginStorage: 对于 tccli 建议用 API Token 方式，凭据会加密存储，操作也简单。
tencent.permissions: 访问密钥继承所属用户的全部权限；如需限权，请使用受限 CAM 子用户的密钥。
tencent.verification: 此处只验证身份，不检查业务权限。
tencent.storage: 密钥会存入系统凭据管理器，供 banyan 内部的 tccli 使用。
tencent.environmentHint: 暂不提供设置。仅检查是否存在，不检查是否有效。

zh.priority: 优先级: 登录授权 < API Token < 环境变量（设置一种就行）
